main.remarks: The Tool is a foundation for business workflows. It stores DataItems and hosts Services and Commands, which define specialized compartmentalized functionality. Configuration, Inputs, Outputs, Logger, Status, and WorkingSet are available, as well as an Access Manager and Dependency Injection Container.

method.name: Starting_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Starting lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. A finite startup timeout cooperatively cancels hosted child operations; children that ignore cancellation may continue after the phase fails.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Starting phase was entered.

method.name: Start_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Start lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. Atomically enter or continue the Starting state, run hosted child operations, and enter Active on successful completion. A finite startup timeout cooperatively cancels hosted child operations; children that ignore cancellation may continue after the phase fails.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Starting state was entered or continued, the Start phase completed, and the Tool entered Active.

method.name: Started_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Started lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. The phase proceeds only while the Tool is Active. A finite startup timeout cooperatively cancels hosted child operations; children that ignore cancellation may continue after the phase fails.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Tool is Active and the Started phase completed.

method.name: Activate_NoSync
method.summary: Activate Tool without waiting for the LifeState lock.
method.returns: True if Tool activated successfully.

method.name: Stopping_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Stopping lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. The phase enters Stopping before hosted child operations run. A finite shutdown timeout cooperatively cancels hosted child operations; children that ignore cancellation may continue after the phase fails.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Stopping phase was entered and completed.

method.name: Stop_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Stop lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. Atomically enter or continue the Stopping state, run hosted child operations, and enter InActive on successful completion. A finite shutdown timeout cooperatively cancels hosted child operations; children that ignore cancellation may continue after the phase fails.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Stopping state was entered or continued, the Stop phase completed, and the Tool entered InActive.

method.name: Stopped_NoSync
method.summary: Run the Stopped lifecycle phase without acquiring the Life lock. The phase proceeds only while the Tool is InActive. A finite shutdown timeout cooperatively cancels hosted child operations; children that ignore cancellation may continue after the phase fails.
method.returns: Lifecycle phase task; the result is true when the Tool is InActive and the Stopped phase completed.

method.name: WaitForOutputAsync
method.summary: Wait for an output to be published, or return one already stored, within a shared timeout budget.
method.param: Original timeout budget, including the infinite-timeout sentinel.
Monotonic timestamp at which the timeout budget began.
method.returns: The stored or published output, or null if the wait times out, is canceled, or Tool disposal begins while waiting.
method.remarks: Coordinates access to the output dictionary and waiter registry with the output semaphore. A pending waiter is removed if its wait does not complete. Disposal drains admitted waiters with a null result and prevents new waiters from registering.
